column1: # The test262 classification table: every file of the pinned corpus is named by
# a row here, or the gate fails. The first row that matches a file decides, so
# the order is part of the table. A row that matches no file also fails the gate
# (the table stays exact), except `unicode-newer:`, whose matches at a given pin
#   toplevel:        a file directly in the repository root
#   nonjs:           a file whose name does not end in .js (test262's own runner
#   suffix:<text>    a file whose path ends with <text>
#   unicode-newer:   a file generated for a Unicode version above the engine's
#                    pinned one (the version in its name or its header)
#   in               a test: it runs in the modes its flags select
#   include          a harness file: parsed as a Script, sloppy and strict
#   fixture          an imported module: parsed as a Module; in scope when some
#                    test or fixture that imports it is in scope
#   fixture-refuse   a fixture that the importing test requires to be a
#   out              skipped, with the reason, which is counted and printed
